name: Audience submit
summary: The one primary action on the audience phone: a touch-size aha-button in the deck accent, in the deck font, with the busy, submitted and submissions-closed states and the submission lock that survives an iframe remount.
highlights: aha-button size="touch" in the deck accent
Busy on tap, then lock(value) or unlock()
Submitted and closed states with a lock glyph
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-audience-submit> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Button
spec.value: <aha-button variant="primary" size="touch" block>: 48px, radius 8, 16px semibold, full width

spec.label: Fill
spec.value: the deck accent via --aha-button-primary-* (applyDeck); label the readable #1A1A1A or white for it

spec.label: Font
spec.value: the deck font (font-family inherited into the button)

spec.label: Locked / closed
spec.value: system-lock glyph + caption, DS disabled grey, same size

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: lock-key
props.desc: The submission-lock key for this question: once a submission is locked under it, the element locks and restores the submitted value, including after an iframe remount

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Nothing to submit yet: the DS neutral grey

props.name: loading
props.desc: Set on tap; cleared by lock() or unlock()

props.name: closed / closed-label
props.desc: The host stopped submissions: lock glyph and caption in place, no reflow

props.name: lock(value) / unlock()
props.desc: Lock after the host accepted the answer (writes the submission lock under lock-key); release after a refusal

props.name: submit-answer
props.desc: Fires on tap while open; the button is busy until lock() or unlock()

whenToUse.when: the one primary action per audience screen
skip, change, back: a second primary means neither is the submit

opinion.note: Announce the submission with the host toast (xprops.showToastSuccess), then move to the submitted or waiting state; never an in-iframe banner. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
